verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs describe completing tasks on websites: shopping and checkout "across the internet" with one-time cards, saved logins in a credential store, booking trips and finding deals. It also runs on its own computer with a terminal. That points to web task completion, but no evidence explicitly says Muse drives a web browser or does web research by browsing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a browser-operation capability, evidence of web research and navigation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of browsing on arbitrary sites.
